title: At Sotheby’s $378.7 M. Doubleheader, Buyers Take Risks Again, Even as Bidding
summary: The Ted and Ruth Baum collection sold every lot, and Yayoi Kusama set a new auction record, but a slow second half showed collectors are still choosy.

title: Yayoi Kusama ‘Infinity Net’ Painting Sells for $15.1 M. at Sotheby’s, Setting a Record
summary: The work, No. 3P.B. (1960), was estimated at $10 million to $15 million.

title: Who Sat for Jan van Eyck’s Arnolfini Portrait? A New Catalog Essay Suggests It May Have Been the Artist
summary: A catalog essay for the exhibition “Van Eyck: The Portraits” posits that the man in the Early Netherlandish master’s 1434 painting is Van Eyck himself

title: Sotheby’s Hospices de Beaune Charity Wine Sale Nets $15.8 M. in France, with One Barrel Selling for Record $1.1 M.
summary: The annual Hospices de Beaune charity wine auction in Burgundy, France, organized by Sotheby’s, generated €14.4 million ($15.8 million) on Sunday.

title: Arta Moves Beyond Shipping Art, to Helping Collectors Pay for It
summary: The art logistics company is expanding into financing, allowing collectors to pay for purchases over ten months while galleries and auction houses receive payment in full.

title: Video Artist Pipilotti Rist Wins MIT’s $100,000 Arts Award
summary: She will soon stage an installation at the Guggenheim Abu Dhabi.
